name: ifx-portal
description: InfinityRx portal monorepo root. Contains the operator portal (portal/operator) and the shared codebase (portal/shared) consumed via npm workspaces. Future portal apps (member, manufacturer) would be added as siblings under this root.

scripts._comment: Workspace-level scripts: prefer running the operator's own scripts via working-directory: portal/operator. These root-level forwarders exist for convenience.
